  [inst_1 : @DecidableRel.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1} V V (@SimpleGraph.Adj.{u_1} V G)],

classification: Only two compiler-generated determinant runtime stages. Neither is authored as unsafe, and neither is reachable from any safe authored declaration or theorem. Fresh compilation and strict source replay supply Lean kernel checking; the inspector enforces the permitted-axiom and unsafe-dependency policy on all 43 safe roots. Helpers are explicitly recorded, not accepted as proof dependencies.
negative_controls: One valid fixture accepted; custom axiom, transitive custom axiom, sorry, native_decide and unsafe fixtures rejected as expected.
limitations: Pinned cached Mathlib imports byte-matched stock; Mathlib itself not rebuilt.
Report/PDF and auxiliary scripts checked separately.
inspector_field_meaning: trust_enforced records the dependency policy being enforced. The inspector is not a separate kernel rechecker.
